title: Sliding window
description: A sliding window keeps track of a contiguous range of elements and adjusts its edges as it moves, instead of recomputing a result from scratch each time. It is the go-to technique whenever a problem asks about a substring or subarray that satisfies some condition.

title: Stack
description: A stack holds items in last-in-first-out order, so the most recently added item is the first one removed. It naturally models nested structures like parentheses, undo history, or finding the next greater or smaller value in a sequence.
